extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting short speculative fiction to Strange Horizons (authors of short stories, flash, and translations)
extracted.subtask_short: submitting speculative fiction to Strange Horizons
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting speculative fiction (short stories, short-shorts, interactive/hypertext pieces, and translations) to the Strange Horizons fiction desk, covering eligibility, format, rights, payment, and submission procedure. Specific to Strange Horizons' online magazine and its Moksha submission system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptable genre
rubrics_metrics.description: We want: Speculative fiction, broadly defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your story doesn't have a speculative element or strong speculative-fiction sensibilities, it's probably not for us.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word count limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Up to 10,000 words (under 5000 preferred).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We prefer stories under 5,000 words, but we consider stories up to 10,000 words. Note the longer the story, the less likely we are to be interested. The limit is not absolutely inflexible but we can't consider stories much over the limit, not even as serials. We have no minimum wordcount requirement and consider short-short stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: How word count is determined
rubrics_metrics.description: We determine story length by taking the word-processor wordcount and rounding up to the next highest 100 words.

rubrics_metrics.name: File types and manuscript format
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send only RTF, DOC or DOCX files and try to stick to standard manuscript format as much as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Along with your name and contact information in the upper left, you may also add your pronouns (optional). Your legal name does not need to be anywhere on your submission; it will be requested only for contract and payment if accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitted here, via our Moksha submissions system — no email or postal submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In order to track stories correctly, we can only consider stories submitted through that form—no email or paper mail submissions. If you're having trouble submitting, contact fiction@strangehorizons.com with 'QUERY:' at start of subject line.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous and multiple submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: No simultaneous or multiple submissions; no re-submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions sent to us and another venue simultaneously are not allowed. Multiple stories at once from the same author are not allowed. Stories previously submitted to Strange Horizons, even if revised, will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously published in English
rubrics_metrics.description: Previously unpublished in English—we buy first English rights, including audio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We will consider stories which have previously appeared in another language, but have never been published in English.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations policy (Samovar)
rubrics_metrics.description: Special note on translations: our quarterly sister magazine Samovar specializes in translations: we encourage you to submit all translations there first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Samovar and Strange Horizons have independent submissions queues and different editors, and submissions to either magazine are only read for that magazine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment rate and minimum
rubrics_metrics.description: We pay 10¢/word (USD), with a minimum payment of $60.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payment is made within 60 days of contract. We pay by check or PayPal, according to the author's preference. SFWA officially considers Strange Horizons a professional market.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights purchased and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: We buy first-printing world exclusive English-language rights (including audio rights) for six (6) months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After that period, you are free to republish the story elsewhere. We hope you'll allow us to leave the story in our archives indefinitely after it's rotated off the main table of contents, but you have the right to remove your story from the archives at any time after one (1) year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content boundaries — sex, violence, profanity
rubrics_metrics.description: Profanity is fine. Sex or violence in a story should be artistically justified; no excessive gore.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity and representation preference
rubrics_metrics.description: We love fiction from or about diverse perspectives and traditionally under-represented groups, settings, and cultures, written from a non-exoticizing and well-researched position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style and form preferences
rubrics_metrics.description: We enjoy unusual yet readable styles and inventive structures and narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hypertext fiction, interactive fiction, and other stories that explore and exploit the forms available to us may be considered—query first to discuss how to submit these formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political/thematic handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories that address political issues in complex and nuanced ways are of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We prefer writing that resists oversimplification of political issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptable subgenres and global submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome all subgenres and forms of speculative fiction and submissions from anywhere in the world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unacceptable content/types
rubrics_metrics.description: Things we won't consider: poetry or nonfiction; stories above 10,000 words; partial or incomplete stories; unsolicited reprints of works previously published in English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partial or incomplete stories: please don't send us part of a story and ask us to request the rest. Serialized novels or novellas are not considered. Previously submitted stories to Strange Horizons (even revised) are ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover letter expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Your cover letter can be minimal: generally, these should be short and list just a few of your most recent or most relevant publications or workshops.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you've got life experience relevant to your story (e.g. your story takes place on a submarine, and you served on a submarine), please mention that. Cover letters shouldn't include plot synopses or pitches. See the sample cover letters page for examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Autoresponse and follow-up policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We send an autoresponder message in response to every submission we receive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you haven't received an autoresponse within 24 hours after submitting, please query immediately—missing an autoresponse usually means we have an incorrect email address for you and won't be able to contact you when we make a decision on your fiction. If you don't get a response to queries within a month, query again.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal policy
rubrics_metrics.description: After you submit a story, we strongly prefer you don't withdraw it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you withdraw a story, we won't consider any version of that story in the future. If you must withdraw, email fiction@strangehorizons.com telling them you need to withdraw and explain why.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: To contact us for any reason, write to fiction@strangehorizons.com with the word QUERY: at the beginning of your subject line.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add a few words to the subject line to indicate what you're querying about.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission status (open/closed)
rubrics_metrics.description: We are currently closed to submissions. We anticipate opening again for submissions in fall 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the top of the page for current open/closed status before attempting to submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special handling for interactive/hypertext works
rubrics_metrics.description: Hypertext fiction, interactive fiction, and other stories that explore and exploit the forms available to us are of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have such a work you think might be a good fit, please query us to discuss how to submit it.

rubrics_metrics.name: No resubmissions policy
rubrics_metrics.description: No re-submissions: stories previously submitted to Strange Horizons, even if they have been revised, will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple stories and simultaneous submission prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple stories at once from the same author and submissions sent to us and another venue simultaneously are not allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archival presence and removal rights
rubrics_metrics.description: We hope you'll allow us to leave the story in our archives indefinitely after it's rotated off the main table of contents, but you have the right to remove your story from the archives at any time after one (1) year.
